title: Popescu preparation quotient factorization
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, A and Λ commutative k-algebras, A finitely presented over k and Λ Noetherian. For an algebra map h define H(h) to be the radical of the extended singular ideal. Let α:A→Λ be a k-algebra map and q a prime of Λ. A polynomial-base datum consists of an integer m, R=k[X_1,…,X_m], compatible k-algebra structures R→Λ and R→C on a commutative ring C finitely presented over R, and maps β:A→C over k and γ:C→Λ over R, such that γβ=α and H(α)⊆H(γ). A parameter datum consists of an integer r≥1 and π_0,…,π_(r-1) in R. Each π_i maps into q. For each i let B_i be R/(π_j^8:j<i) and T_i be Λ/(image(π_j)^8:j<i). Multiplication by π_i and by π_i² have identical kernels on both B_i and T_i. Each image of π_i in C is strictly standard over R. Define J=(π_i^8) in R, J_C=JC, J_Λ=JΛ, Q=R_(q∩R), L=Λ_q, JQ=J·Q and JL=J·L. Use the induced algebra map Q→L. An auxiliary thickening datum consists of n>0 with m_L^n⊆JL, ideals I⊆Q and K⊆L with I⊆JQ, K⊆JL and IL⊆K, a commutative Q-algebra D, a compatible Q/I-algebra structure on D, and algebra maps f:Q⊗_R C→D and g:D→L/K over Q. Require D to be essentially smooth over Q/I and gf to equal the canonical tensor map induced by Q→L/K and C→Λ→L/K. Given polynomial-base, parameter and auxiliary thickening data as described above, put R₀=R/J, C₀=C/J_C and Λ₀=Λ/J_Λ. Then C₀ is finitely presented over R₀, and there exist an R₀-algebra map γ₀:C₀→Λ₀ and a prime q₀ of Λ₀ such that γ₀ composed with C→C₀ equals γ composed with Λ→Λ₀, and the inverse image of q₀ is q. Either H(γ₀) is not contained in q₀, or q₀ is minimal over H(γ₀), the ring L₀=(Λ₀)_q₀ has Krull dimension zero, and, with P=(R₀)_(q₀∩R₀), there exist a commutative P-algebra E essentially smooth over P and P-algebra maps F:P⊗_(R₀)C₀→E and G:E→L₀ whose composite is the canonical tensor map induced by P→L₀ and γ₀ followed by Λ₀→L₀. The carriers C,D,E have representatives in Type(max u v), where k:Type u and A:Type v; Λ may have an independent universe.

proof.text: Construct the quotient algebra map using Ideal.quotientMapₐ and quotient surjectivity. Since each parameter maps into q, JT is contained in q; map q along the quotient to obtain q₀, and contract it back with Ideal.comap_map_mk. J has finitely many generators; Ideal.FG.map and Algebra.FinitePresentation.quotient give finite presentation of C/JC over R, then Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_restrict_scalars_finitePresentation gives it over R/J.

proof.text: Extract n and the maximal-ideal power bound. For a prime p₀ below q₀, contract to p below q containing JT. Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime makes its extension pL prime; the power bound and Ideal.IsPrime.le_of_pow_le force maximalIdeal L ≤ pL. Contract using Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime and IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal, giving q ≤ p. Map back to the quotient to get q₀ ≤ p₀. This proves q₀ minimal over zero, hence minimal over popescuIdeal γ₀ whenever that ideal is contained in q₀. Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isLocalization and ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero give dimension zero.

theorem popescu_char_p_preparation_quotient
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (m : ℕ) [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ]
      [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ]
    (C : Type (max u v)) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
      [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C]
      [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C]
      [FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C]
    (β : A →ₐ[k] C) (γ : C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin m) k] Λ)
    (r : ℕ) (π : Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hbase : (γ.restrictScalars k).comp β = α ∧ popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ)
    (hparam : 1 ≤ r ∧
      (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin r)
        (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin r)
        (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, IsStrictlyStandardElement
        (R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C (π i))))
    (hconstruction :
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I : Ideal Q) (K : Ideal L),
        I ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧ I.map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra Q D)
          (_ : Algebra (Q ⧸ I) D) (_ : IsScalarTower Q (Q ⧸ I) D),
          EssentiallySmooth (Q ⧸ I) D ∧
          ∃ (f : Q ⊗[R] C →ₐ[Q] D) (g : D →ₐ[Q] L ⧸ K),
            g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId Q (L ⧸ K))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K).comp
                ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R Λ L).comp γ))
              (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)) :
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let J_C := J.map (algebraMap R C)
    let J_Λ := J.map (algebraMap R Λ)
    let R₀ := R ⧸ J
    let C₀ := C ⧸ J_C
    let Λ₀ := Λ ⧸ J_Λ
    ∃ (_ : FinitePresentation R₀ C₀) (γ₀ : C₀ →ₐ[R₀] Λ₀)
      (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum Λ₀),
      γ₀.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_C) =
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ).comp γ.toRingHom ∧
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ) q₀ = q ∧
      (¬ popescuIdeal γ₀ ≤ q₀.asIdeal ∨
        q₀.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal γ₀).minimalPrimes ∧
        ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal) = 0 ∧
        let P := Localization.AtPrime (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀)
        let L := Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal
        letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver
          (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀) q₀.asIdeal
        ∃ (E : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing E) (_ : Algebra P E),
          EssentiallySmooth P E ∧
          ∃ (f : P ⊗[R₀] C₀ →ₐ[P] E) (g : E →ₐ[P] L),
            g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId P L)
              ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R₀ Λ₀ L).comp γ₀)
              (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _))
